name: Tsun DraCsuicide ~Kyuuseishu wa Minimum Bishoujo Kyuuketsuki!?~
original_name: ツンDraCsuicide ～吸精主はミニマム美少女吸血鬼!?～
source:
While wondering about what his life will become from now on after being fired from his part-time job, Yukiya found an unconscious beautiful girl leaning against the trash can behind the store. When trying to help the girl, he is attacked by a homeless beggar. On the verge of dying, he suddenly revives after drinking blood from the girl's finger. Next time, the girl drinks the blood from his wound and get a little better. He then decides to bring the girl home with him since she is still weak.

Later, he learns that the girl is actually vampire and he is now in incomplete state of vampire conversion after drinking her blood. The girl offers to bring him back to human in exchange for him to be her servant and help to recover her power in 7 days. However, she dislikes sucking blood from human so he has to dedicate his semen instead ???
translation:
正当Yukiya思考被解雇后的生活会变成什么样时，Yukiya发现了一个昏迷不醒的美丽女孩靠在商店后面的垃圾桶上。当他试图帮助女孩时，遭到一名无家可归的乞丐的袭击。濒临死亡的他，喝了女孩手指上的血后，突然苏醒。下次，女孩喝了他伤口的血，就会好一点。然后他决定把女孩带回家，因为她仍然很虚弱。

后来，他得知这个女孩实际上是吸血鬼，而他在喝了她的血后现在处于不完全的吸血鬼转化状态。女孩提出将他带回人类，以换取他成为她的仆人并帮助她在7天内恢复力量。然而，她不喜欢吸人类的血，所以他必须奉献他的精液？？？
